description: Two storey rear extension to provide two self-contained residential units,  with creation of roof level access to the rear of 75 Kingsland Road.
subdivision_of_building: The proposed works will be above the existing rear ground floor extension.
decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-4a8b4b39-7fff-8f77-2af0-7ccb003e2325"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">By reason of the proposed dwellings failing to meet the minimum internal space standards; and Flat A 101 failing to provide an acceptable internal living environment owing to lack of outlook, perceived sense of in-looking and insufficient details in relation to daylight having been provided, the development would fail to provide high quality accommodation contrary to Policy D6 of the London Plan (2021), Policy LP17 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020) and the NDSS.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-496b2e73-7fff-2b99-2339-7f41e6075555"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">By reason of the scale, massing and detailed design of the proposed extension, combined with the excessive level of boundary treatments for the proposed access spanning across neighbouring property 75 Kingsland High Street, the development would appear as a dominant enlargement to the host property which would fail to take reference from the prevailing character and appearance of the site and surrounding area and would result in a significant level of visual clutter to the rear of these properties to the detriment of the site and significance of the Dalston Conservation Area. The harm is assessed to be less than substantial to the designated heritage asset which triggers paragraph 215 of the NPPF (2024) requiring the harm to be weighed against the public benefits of the proposals. In this instance there are minor public benefits as a result of the proposed development, however, these benefits are not considered to outweigh the harm to the conservation area. The proposed development would, therefore, conflict with Policies D1, D3, D4 and HC1 of the London Plan, Policy LP1 of the Hackney Local Plan 2020 (2033), and the NPPF (2024).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-224018cc-7fff-4f40-817f-f730935bb0d6"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">In the absence of a Daylight and Sunlight Assessment having been submitted, it has failed to be demonstrated that the proposed development would not materially overshadow neighbouring properties. The proposed development would, therefore, conflict with Policy LP2 of the LP33.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-aa02fd29-7fff-aae6-03d0-f2b85f3479c2"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The proposed development, by reason of a lack of provision of affordable housing, would fail to adequately contribute towards the provision of mixed and balanced communities and housing needs in the local area. As such, the development would not be consistent with Policies H4 and H5 of the London Plan (2021), Policies LP12 and LP13 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020), and the Hackney </span><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">S106 Planning Contributions Supplementary Planning Document (2020)</span><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">.</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-285681ee-7fff-62a1-72ce-eb6d4b766ec4"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">In the absence of a Unilateral Undertaking or a Section 106 agreement securing appropriate mitigation by restricting future occupiers of the development from obtaining parking permits within the Controlled Parking Zone the proposed development would likely exacerbate existing parking stress and congestion on the surrounding highway network. The application is, therefore, contrary to Policy LP45 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020) and Policy T6 of the London Plan (2021). </span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-d266587a-7fff-981e-f249-26e67eb2041f"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">In the absence of a legal agreement securing the financial contribution towards carbon off-setting has not been submitted or completed, the proposal would therefore fail to secure sufficient energy efficiency measures and/or financial contribution towards carbon offsetting, the proposed development would result in an unacceptable level of carbon dioxide emissions, contrary to Policy LP55 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).</span></span></p>

<p><span id="docs-internal-guid-32325e1a-7fff-e3f7-409c-cf211d2b2297"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Insufficient information with regard to the provision of waste and recycling storage and management, the application, therefore, fails to accord with Policy LP57 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).</span></span></p>
